dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), compiled with open-cobol (GnuCOBOL); comment references 'open-cobol 0.23' migration in 2005
evidence: SELECT ASSIGN without ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL typical of GnuCOBOL/open-cobol

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software – monthly statement / inpatient billing summary report
purpose.summary: This program (A00000D126) is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It generates a monthly inpatient/outpatient billing summary table (月次台帳・月計表), retrieving patient admission/discharge records and computing insurance charges, self-pay amounts, subsidies, and consumption tax. It reads patient files, insurance combination data, and system management tables, then produces a formatted report.

notable_features: 43 COPY statements referencing JMA ORCA-specific copybooks (CPCOMMONSHELL.INC, A00000D126.INC, CPERRFL.INC, etc.)
134 CALL statements indicating heavy use of shared subroutines
Indexed file (ORGANIZATION INDEXED, DYNAMIC access) for patient data
High comment ratio (43%) with Japanese-language change history
Latin-1 decoded but contains Shift-JIS/EUC-JP Japanese text in comments
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
Program option support via INI file (partially deleted in 2009 revision)
OCCURS clauses for insurance category arrays
Signed numeric fields with decimal positions (V9) for rate calculations
verdict.notes: File is ~217KB, 4984 lines; truncated to 16000 chars for analysis but structure is clear. Japanese comments are encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but the file was decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in displayed text. The program is clearly production-grade JMA ORCA healthcare software with a long revision history from 2004 to 2009.
